question: By whose power and agency does the yoginī named Icchā extend up to māyā?
premises: The scope extends up to māyā by supreme will.
inference: The yoginī Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, extends up to māyā.
uncertainties: The exact verbal action governing māyāntaṃ is implicit.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the siddhas and through supreme will, extends up to māyā.
